name: Dominique's
cuisine: Upscale steakhouse and seafood with Southern influence
lastReview: today, about 10 in the last 4 days
hook: About 70 new Google reviews a month, 1,240 in total. The steak and seafood rooms you compete with are running two to three times that.
praise: Attentive servers who know the menu and recommend well
Seafood trio, rasta pasta and crab cakes cooked right
Elegant room chosen for date nights and birthdays
The Friday live band brings people back
complaints: Slow service and long waits for food
Inconsistent plates: overcooked fish, salty sides, dry chicken
talkingPoints: You are at about 70 reviews a month; STK Midtown is at 219 and Atlanta Fish Market at 119 over the same 30 days, so the gap is volume, not food.
Google's April 2026 rules ban asking guests to include a staff name, and about two thirds of your recent reviews name a server; a neutral card at every table protects the 1,240 you already have.
Kampai and Rockin Crab sit within half a mile with 1,900 and 1,500 reviews; steady volume is what keeps you first for steak searches near the mall.
likelyObjection: "Our servers already ask every table for a Google review." Answer: Then the cards cost you nothing new; they make the ask identical at every table, remove the typing for the guest, and the report turns the volume you already have into a monthly read on service and the kitchen.
offer: Start with 10 cards and the monthly report: $200 today, then $50 a month. Cancel anytime.
notes: Only one Dominique's exists near Stonecrest; it sits in the former Arizona's building beside The Mall at Stonecrest, off I-20 exit 75. Some listings still say Lithonia, GA 30038. Parking is the restaurant's own lot on the mall outparcel. Hours per the official site: Mon-Thu 12-10pm, Fri-Sat 12-11pm, Sun 12-9pm; lunch Mon-Fri 12-3pm; brunch Sat-Sun 12-3pm. Closed Labor Day, Monday Sept 7, 2026. Avoid Friday evenings (live band) and weekend brunch; a weekday between 3pm and 5pm is the quietest window. Happy hour runs afternoons into 7pm; the owner's Google post says 4-7pm while reviews mention 3-7pm. No owner or manager name appears on the business's own site or social pages, so ask for the owner or general manager. Phone (470) 837-7617; Facebook also lists (470) 679-3170; email Info@dominiquesatstonecrest.com. The site runs on Popmenu and shows a $500 drawing for on-site dish reviews (drawing 10/1). Do not tie the NFC card to that drawing; Google prohibits incentivized reviews. Roughly 68% of the newest 60 Google reviews name a server, often posted within minutes on the same night, so staff already ask at the table. None of the newest 60 Google reviews had an owner reply, including a 1-star posted today about a tip charge. Third-party hours conflict on Yelp, EatOkra and Restaurantji, which is a listings-cleanup talking point. Google flags the listing as Black-owned and women-owned, price $30-90 per person. Social: Facebook @dominiquesstonecrest, Instagram @dominiquesatstonecrest, TikTok @dominiquesatstonecrest. Logo is a black script wordmark; if the pack needs a dark color use #101010, with #E6D0A9 as the gold accent. Smokey Bones next door closed in April 2026, so a nearby review-volume competitor is gone. Card accent uses a darker shade of the site's champagne gold (#E6D0A9) for print legibility. A FOX 5 Atlanta segment from July 2024 names the owner as Cheryl; that is press-sourced, so confirm at the host stand before using it. Apple Maps shows 67% on 39 ratings and Yelp 3.0 on 68, so off-Google sentiment lags Google; mention only if they bring up Yelp. Review velocity measured Aug 13 to Sep 5 2026 is about 66 to 76 a month, so say 'about 70', never '50'. Benchmarks counted over Aug 6 to Sep 5 2026: STK Midtown 219/mo (25,120 total, 4.6), Atlanta Fish Market 119/mo (10,314, 4.6), Fogo de Chao Buckhead 94/mo (15,905, 4.7), Twin Peaks Kennesaw 156/mo, Mary Mac's 91/mo. Famous national names are weak comparisons: Franklin Barbecue runs about 23 a month. If he pushes back that those rooms are bigger, agree; the card raises the share of guests who review, which is the lever a smaller room controls. The zero-owner-replies observation from the review scrape was never verified on Google Maps, so check it on your phone before saying it out loud.
